name: Microsoft Lists
summary: Microsoft's app for tracking information in lists.

flows.title: Create a list
steps: With a work or school account, go to microsoft365.com and select App launcher, More apps, All apps, then Lists.
Choose how to create it: Blank list, From existing list, From Excel or From CSV.
Choose the options for the list, then select Create.
To add items, select + Add new item, fill in the form, and select Save.

flows.title: Add an item to a list
steps: Above the list, select + New or + Add new item to open the New item window.
Enter the item's information. To attach files, select Add attachments, locate the file, and select Open.

flows.title: Share a list or list item
steps: Go to the list, or select the list item, and select Share.
Enter the names of the people or groups to share it with.
Select the pencil icon to the right to set their level of access.
Include a message if you want, then select Send.
